svg.title: The inflection — 2,392 GitHub contributions in 12 months
svg.desc: Contribution heatmap from 26 Oct 2025 to 26 Oct 2026. Near-empty for six months, ramping from mid-year, peaking at 142 on 13 Sep during sprint #57.
svg.text: Quiet for six months. Then the loop switched on.
